topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band, a combination of strategies is needed. Adaptive beamforming, beam diversity, and advanced precoding techniques can be employed to minimize the impact of narrow beams on efficiency. Joint transmit-receive beamforming optimization using techniques like alternating optimization, convex relaxation, and machine learning can also be used to optimize joint beamforming. Additionally, balancing digital and analog beamforming costs, considering the trade-offs between directivity and coverage, is crucial. By implementing these strategies, it is possible to achieve efficient spectrum sharing and minimize efficiency fluctuations in mmWave bands.
